title: Bar Series Strawberry Coconut Watermelon 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Strawberry Coconut Watermelon by Bar Series delivers an exotic fruit blend with a smooth, summery twist. Sweet Strawberry takes the lead with its bright, sun-ripened flavour, while creamy Coconut brings a soft, mellow character to the mix. Watermelon adds a fresh, lightly juicy finish that ties the blend together into a smooth, fruity vape with subtle tropical tones. Formulated with nicotine salts, this e-liquid delivers a smooth, yet tactile throat hit and rapid nicotine uptake. It's blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, making it ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping with refillable vapes , pod vape kits and vape starter kits . Explore Bar Series' wide range of flavours, which includes fruit blends, confectionery, icy menthols and many more exciting profiles crafted with extra-concentrated flavour for intense taste. Bar Series e-liquids cater to all vapers by offering 5mg, 10mg and 20mg nic salts designed to perform perfectly in your favourite pod kit.
